07937e71.text:
Lady Mara Fordragon

High Clerist of Stormwind

Patron of the Refugees who fled to Lordaeron after the First War.

She was the bright mother of our future. May she rest in the Light.
07937e71.title: Lady Mara Fordragon

8ee94608.text: With the absence of trolls in the northlands, the elves of Quel'Thalas bent their efforts towards rebuilding their glorious homeland. The victorious armies of Arathor returned home to southlands of Strom.
8ee94608.title: The Guardians of Tirisfal

bb664155.text: Lord Lothar rallied the remnants of Azeroth's armies after their defeat at Stormwind Keep, and then launched a massive exodus across the sea to the northern kingdom of Lordaeron. Convinced that the Horde would overcome all of humanity if left unchecked, the leaders of the seven $r nations met and agreed to unite in what would become known as the Alliance of Lordaeron.
bb664155.title: The Alliance of Lordaeron

ea53b57a.text:
The devastating Second War against the orcish horde left the Alliance of Lordaeron in a state of shock and disarray. The bloodthirsty orcs, led by the mighty warchief, Orgrim Doomhammer, not only smashed their way through the dwarf-held lands of Khaz Modan, but had razed many of Lordaeron's central provinces as well. The unrelenting orcs even succeeded in ravaging the
elves' remote kingdom of Quel'Thalas before their rampage was finally stopped.
ea53b57a.title: Aftermath of the Second War

1289|ed056522.name: Gunther Weller
1289|ed056522.text: Best deals in all of Stormwind my friend, won't find any better. Now, what can I help you with?

14450|d3e1a5a0.name: Orphan Matron Nightingale
14450|d3e1a5a0.text:
There are costs with war, $c... ones often overlooked.  Those costs are the orphans - children who have lost their parents to the far-too-numerous conflicts that rage across Azeroth.  Those children who have no one else to turn to often come here to live until they are old enough to fend for themselves.

One week out of the year during the Spring, the Alliance takes time to give something back to these innocents.  This time is called Children's Week.

1480|4d61ac25.name: Caitlin Grassman
1480|4d61ac25.text: Alchemy can help so many people! It's my life's passion.

1976|9e9bec9c.name: Stormwind City Patroller
1976|9e9bec9c.text: What do you need directions to?

2327|2957a3a0.name: Shaina Fuller
2327|2957a3a0.text: Oh, a fellow Physician. I would be glad to teach you anything that would aid your journeys.

2456|105cd232.name: Newton Burnside
2456|105cd232.text: No one's ever stolen anything out of here. Not in the whole history of... the whole history!

2456|2237a3b1.name: Newton Burnside
2456|2237a3b1.text: Welcome to the Bank of Stormwind. We offer financial accounts and safety deposit boxes for valuable items. Do you already have an account with us sir?

2504|60988031.name: Donyal Tovald
2504|60988031.text: Please clean yourself before handling our tomes.

268568|f87f742d.name: Roy Lewells
268568|f87f742d.text: Literacy should be celebrated and shared.

270581|e6b98502.name: Fyrenz Vishonar
270581|e6b98502.text:
Greetings, $c.

I can show you how to weave magic about yourself to change the appearance of your equipment, if you so desire. Do you wish to utilize my services?

5479|7a171557.name: Wu Shen
5479|7a171557.text: Stormwind is the pillar of the $r race, maintained through strength of will and the edge of a sturdy blade.

5502|fb513610.name: Shylamiir
5502|fb513610.text: I hope that your interruption is for a good cause, I was in the middle of some important work.

5504|cf843c85.name: Sheldras Moontree
5504|cf843c85.text: Even within cold, stone walls such as the ones that shelter this town, one may find tranquility and peace.  In fact, you may find them everywhere you are... simply look inside yourself for such balance.

5506|cf843c85.name: Maldryn
5506|cf843c85.text: Even within cold, stone walls such as the ones that shelter this town, one may find tranquility and peace.  In fact, you may find them everywhere you are... simply look inside yourself for such balance.

5511|5ca9cced.name: Therum Deepforge
5511|5ca9cced.text: Ye have the look of a Blacksmith to ye. Soot under the nails, steel in yer bones. Aye, very much the blood of a Blacksmith in yer veins. Which means ye've come to me looking to learn a thing or two, well lad grab a hammer. Let's see what I can teach ye.

5512|211be282.name: Kaita Deepforge
5512|211be282.text: Don't let the humans in the Bazaar fool ye lad, with the subway those gnomes built it's easier than ye might think to transport goods from Ironforge. If they try to tack on import fees just tell them yer gonna buy yer gear from me.

6740|c80041d2.name: Innkeeper Allison
6740|c80041d2.text: Welcome to my Inn, weary traveler. What can I do for you?

928|837f02f9.name: Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker
928|837f02f9.text: May the Light protect you this day.

957|a7a421b8.name: Dane Lindgren
957|a7a421b8.text: A far better blacksmith than I am, that's for sure. Though I'll deny it if you tell anyone I said that. You should go speak with Therum Deepforge. If anyone can teach you more, it's him.
